CommunityApplications.Profile:
An Unraid template and container image for [Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata), which runs the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model on one NVIDIA GPU plus system RAM with an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API.
The image is built from Strata's own Dockerfile, patched so it runs on any AVX2 CPU, and published to GHCR by this repository's CI. It is unofficial: report template or image problems in this repository's issues, not to the Strata project.
